options.text: Bicycle maintenance, including replacing damaged parts without outside help.
options.zh: 單車保養，包括不求助就能自行更換受損零件。
options.whyZh: 課程教辨識何時需專業維修，不是教大家自己替換受損零件。

options.text: Basic bicycle checks and adjustments, plus deciding when a repair needs an expert.
options.zh: 單車基本檢查與調整，也學習何時要找專業人士維修。
options.whyZh: 課程結合胎壓、座椅調整等基本動作，也教判斷何時應找專業人士。

options.text: Bicycle maintenance, mainly choosing and buying a complete toolkit.
options.zh: 單車保養，重點是選購整套工具。
options.whyZh: 中心提供工具，不要求事前選購，也沒說課程以買工具為主。

options.text: Bicycle maintenance, with professionals completing every repair on site.
options.zh: 單車保養，由專業人士在現場完成所有維修。
options.whyZh: 課程教如何判斷需不需要專業修理，未承諾由專業人士在現場完成所有維修。

explanationZh: 課程結合胎壓、座椅調整等基本動作，也教判斷何時應找專業人士。
evidence: Participants will learn to check tire pressure, adjust a seat, and identify when professional repairs are needed. | Tools will be provided, so there is no need to buy any in advance.
